scouting.summary: Bounces on the outside, feints, then blitzes in with a straight punch or a head kick and is gone again.
strengths: Fast, long and hard to hit
weaknesses: Light hands: rarely hurts you with punches
Lost if you trap him on the fence or take him down
scouting.tell: When his jab is blocked he throws the head kick.
scouting.how_to_beat: Cut off the cage, don't chase in straight lines, and take him down when he plants for a kick.
